newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank sets unchanged 4.10 pct repo rate.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank sets unchanged 4.10 pct repo rate.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set a one-week reverse repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent.
The operation will run from January 29 to February 5.
Primary dealers are invited to leave their bids with the Riksbank by 0900 GMT on January 28.
The repo rate moves inside the Riksbank's interest rate corridor. The ceiling or lending rate now stands at 5.25 percent and the corridor's floor or deposit rate is 3.75 percent.

Ahead of the announcement analysts were divided on whether the Riksbank would lower the repo rate. Seven out of 12 analysts said the Riksbank would leave the repo rate unchanged at 4.10 percent but five forecast a 15 to 20 basis point cut.
